title: Acceptance: add_expense
prompt: Contract: add_expense(expenses, amount, category, note="") returns a NEW list with {"amount": float, "category": lowercase str, "note": str} appended. amount must be a number > 0 and category non-empty, else raise ValueError. Input list must never be mutated.

tests.name: validation and purity
tests.code:
e0 = [{"amount": 5.0, "category": "food", "note": ""}]
r = add_expense(e0, 12.5, "Transport")
assert r == e0 + [{"amount": 12.5, "category": "transport", "note": ""}], f"got {r}"
assert e0 == [{"amount": 5.0, "category": "food", "note": ""}], "input mutated!"
for bad in [(0, "food"), (-3, "food"), (5, "")]:
    try:
        add_expense([], *bad)
        assert False, f"{bad} must raise"
    except ValueError:
        pass
assert add_expense([], 10, "food", "lunch")[0]["note"] == "lunch", "note defaults and stores"
tests.hint: amount = float(amount) after validating > 0; category = category.strip().lower().
